name: duopore-public-two-minute-next-step
description: Turn a task that feels large into a small first step you choose.
keywords: find a small way to start

interface.shortDescription: Find a small way to start
interface.longDescription: Turn a task that feels large into a small first step you choose. Share the task, a clear starter action, a cue to begin and how you will know that step is done. Get a simple start card. For adults planning their own tasks. A two-minute first step starts the work; it does not claim to finish the whole task.
capabilities: Find a small way to start
defaultPrompt: Turn this task into a clear two-minute starting step.
Make a start card from my task, cue and chosen first action.

positive.prompt: Use Two-minute Next-step Card with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"goal":"Organize study notes","task":"Sort all course notes into my subject folders.","fullTaskMinutes":25,"starterStep":"Place the first three note files in the statistics folder.","starterMinutes":2,"cue":"After I open my course folder","stopWhen":"The three files are in the chosen folder."}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
